# Reverbex Technology

> Reverbex Technology is an AI systems studio based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founder: Anurag Singh. The studio builds custom software and AI systems for businesses in India and works remotely with clients elsewhere.

Canonical website: https://www.reverbex.in

## Services
- AI agents: WhatsApp sales/support agents, enquiry qualification and internal operations workflows with human hand-off.
- Custom MCP servers: Model Context Protocol integrations that expose selected business tools and data to compatible AI applications, with permissions configured for the project.
- AI automation: n8n workflows, RAG chatbots grounded in business documents, lead routing and follow-ups.
- Web and app development: Next.js websites and web apps, Flutter Android/iOS apps, Python/FastAPI backends, CRM systems, financial dashboards and commerce integrations.

## Monthly pricing (INR)
- Launch: Rs 15,000/month. Website or web app, one automation or RAG chatbot, WhatsApp lead capture, SEO/AI visibility setup and monthly improvements.
- Grow: Rs 30,000/month. Launch scope plus Android app, WhatsApp commerce/AI agent, order and lead workflows, priority support.
- Scale: Rs 70,000/month. Grow scope plus Android/iOS apps, custom CRM, financial dashboards, AI agents, custom MCP servers, Python backends and monitoring.
- Scope, taxes, setup costs and commitment are confirmed in a written proposal. Larger custom builds are quoted after a free audit. Delivery dates depend on integrations, data access and testing; milestones are agreed before development.
